common.tagline: Your Health. Your Records. Your Control.

landing.heroDesc: MediTrack provides patients and doctors with unified, tamper-proof medical records and smart digital prescriptions with full patient control.
landing.howItWorksDesc: From clinic check-in to verified prescriptions, every step is built around patient privacy and doctor convenience.
landing.step1Desc: Sign up in 30 seconds as a patient or verified medical professional. Patients receive a unique secure QR identity.
landing.step2Desc: Present your personal QR code at the clinic. The doctor scans it to securely load your profile and history.
landing.step3Desc: You maintain complete ownership. Approve or revoke doctor access to past records with time-limited permissions.
landing.step4Desc: Doctors speak naturally during consultation. MediTrack AI extracts condition, symptoms, and dosages automatically.
landing.step5Desc: Review and confirm structured prescriptions instantly. Patients access dosages, timings, and instructions anytime.
landing.forPatientsPoint1: Always have your medical history and active prescriptions in your pocket.
landing.forPatientsPoint2: Grant or revoke doctor access anytime with instant revocable permissions.
landing.forPatientsPoint3: Never lose a physical prescription or struggle to read doctor handwriting again.
landing.forDoctorsPoint1: Voice-enabled consultation drafting powered by intelligent medical AI.
landing.forDoctorsPoint2: Instant access to patient timeline and previous treatments with patient consent.
landing.forDoctorsPoint3: Structured clinical findings with verified digital audit logs.
landing.securityTitle: Your Medical Data is Protected & Encrypted
landing.securityDesc: We prioritize patient privacy and medical data integrity at every level.
landing.secCard1Desc: All clinical records and prescriptions are encrypted in transit and at rest.
landing.secCard2Desc: Doctors cannot see past records without your explicit, time-boxed authorization.
landing.secCard3Desc: Every treatment creation, update, and access request is recorded for complete transparency.
